planets.name: HD 715 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 715 with a 56.4-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: HD 715 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 715. Its orbit and size follow Venner et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname VENNER_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2026, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 56.4, pl_radj 1.07, pl_bmassj 0.635
